verses.en: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.
verses.pt: Logo de manhã tiveram conselho os principais sacerdotes com os anciãos, os escribas e todo o sinédrio; e maniatando a Jesus, o levaram e o entregaram a Pilatos.
verses.en_web: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders and scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.
verses.en_bbe: And the first thing in the morning the chief priests, with those in authority and the scribes and all the Sanhedrin, had a meeting, and put cords round Jesus, and took him away, and gave him up to Pilate.

verses.en: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest it.
verses.pt: Pilatos lhe perguntou: És tu o rei dos judeus? Respondeu-lhe Jesus: É como dizes.
verses.en_web: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”
verses.en_bbe: And Pilate put a question to him, Are you the King of the Jews? And he, answering, said to him, You say so.

verses.en: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.
verses.pt: e os principais dos sacerdotes o acusavam de muitas coisas.
verses.en_web: The chief priests accused him of many things.
verses.en_bbe: And the chief priests said a number of things against him.

verses.en: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.
verses.pt: Tornou Pilatos a interrogá-lo, dizendo: Não respondes nada? Vê quantas acusações te fazem.
verses.en_web: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”
verses.en_bbe: And Pilate again put a question, Do you say nothing in answer? see how much evil they say you have done.

verses.en: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.
verses.pt: Mas Jesus nada mais respondeu, de maneira que Pilatos se admirava.
verses.en_web: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.
verses.en_bbe: But Jesus gave no more answers, so that Pilate was full of wonder.

verses.en: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.
verses.pt: Ora, por ocasião da festa costumava soltar-lhes um preso qualquer que eles pedissem.
verses.en_web: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whom they asked of him.
verses.en_bbe: Now at the feast every year he let one prisoner go free at their request.

verses.en: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.
verses.pt: E havia um, chamado Barrabás, preso com outros sediciosos, os quais num motim haviam cometido um homicídio.
verses.en_web: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.
verses.en_bbe: And there was one named Barabbas, in prison with those who had gone against the government and in the fight had taken life.

verses.en: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.
verses.pt: E a multidão subiu e começou a pedir o que lhe costumava fazer.
verses.en_web: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.
verses.en_bbe: And the people went up, requesting him to do as he had done for them in other years.

verses.en: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
verses.pt: Ao que Pilatos lhes perguntou: Quereis que vos solte o rei dos judeus?
verses.en_web: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
verses.en_bbe: And Pilate said in answer to them, Is it your desire that I let the King of the Jews go free?

verses.en: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.
verses.pt: Pois ele sabia que por inveja os principais sacerdotes lho haviam entregado.
verses.en_web: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.
verses.en_bbe: For he saw that the chief priests had given him up through envy.

verses.en: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
verses.pt: Mas os principais sacerdotes incitaram a multidão a pedir que lhes soltasse antes a Barrabás.
verses.en_web: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.
verses.en_bbe: But the people were moved by the chief priests to make him let Barabbas go free.

verses.en: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?
verses.pt: E Pilatos, tornando a falar, perguntou-lhes: Que farei então daquele a quem chamais reis dos judeus?
verses.en_web: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”
verses.en_bbe: And Pilate again said in answer to them, What then am I to do to him to whom you give the name of the King of the Jews?

verses.en: And they cried out again, Crucify him.
verses.pt: Novamente clamaram eles: Crucifica-o!
verses.en_web: They cried out again, “Crucify him!”
verses.en_bbe: And they said again loudly, To the cross with him!

verses.en: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.
verses.pt: Disse-lhes Pilatos: Mas que mal fez ele? Ao que eles clamaram ainda mais: Crucifica-o!
verses.en_web: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”
verses.en_bbe: And Pilate said to them, Why, what evil has he done? But their cry was the louder, To the cross!

verses.en: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
verses.pt: Então Pilatos, querendo satisfazer a multidão, soltou-lhe Barrabás; e tendo mandado açoitar a Jesus, o entregou para ser crucificado.
verses.en_web: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.
verses.en_bbe: And Pilate, desiring to do what was pleasing to the people, let Barabbas go free, and gave up Jesus, when he had been whipped, to be put to death on the cross.

verses.en: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.
verses.pt: Os soldados, pois, levaram-no para dentro, ao pátio, que é o pretório, e convocaram toda a coorte;
verses.en_web: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.
verses.en_bbe: And the men of the army took him away into the square in front of the building which is the Praetorium, and they got together all the band.

verses.en: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,
verses.pt: vestiram-no de púrpura e puseram-lhe na cabeça uma coroa de espinhos que haviam tecido;
verses.en_web: They clothed him with purple, and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.
verses.en_bbe: And they put a purple robe on him, and twisting a crown of thorns, they put it on him;

verses.en: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!
verses.pt: e começaram a saudá-lo: Salve, rei dos judeus!
verses.en_web: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
verses.en_bbe: And, as if honouring him, they said, Long life to the King of the Jews!

verses.en: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
verses.pt: Davam-lhe com uma cana na cabeça, cuspiam nele e, postos de joelhos, o adoravam.
verses.en_web: They struck his head with a reed, and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.
verses.en_bbe: And they gave him blows on the head with a stick and put shame on him and, going down on their knees, gave him worship.

verses.en: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.
verses.pt: Depois de o terem assim escarnecido, despiram-lhe a púrpura, e lhe puseram as vestes. Então o levaram para fora, a fim de o crucificarem.
verses.en_web: When they had mocked him, they took the purple off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.
verses.en_bbe: And when they had made sport of him, they took the purple robe off him and put his clothing on him. And they took him out to put him to death on the cross.

verses.en: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.
verses.pt: E obrigaram certo Simão, cireneu, pai de Alexandre e de Rufo, que por ali passava, vindo do campo, a carregar-lhe a cruz.
verses.en_web: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them, that he might bear his cross.
verses.en_bbe: And they made one, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, who was going by, coming from the country, go with them, so that he might take his cross.

verses.en: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.
verses.pt: Levaram-no, pois, ao lugar do Gólgota, que quer dizer, lugar da Caveira.
verses.en_web: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”
verses.en_bbe: And they took him to the place named Golgotha, which is, Dead Man's Head.

verses.en: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
verses.pt: E ofereciam-lhe vinho misturado com mirra; mas ele não o tomou.
verses.en_web: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.
verses.en_bbe: And they gave him wine mixed with myrrh; but he did not take it.

verses.en: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.
verses.pt: Então o crucificaram, e repartiram entre si as vestes dele, lançando sortes sobre elas para ver o que cada um levaria.
verses.en_web: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.
verses.en_bbe: And he was nailed to the cross; and they made a division of his clothing among them, putting to the decision of chance what everyone was to take.

verses.en: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.
verses.pt: E era a hora terceira quando o crucificaram.
verses.en_web: It was the third hour, and they crucified him.
verses.en_bbe: And it was the third hour when they put him on the cross.

verses.en: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.pt: Por cima dele estava escrito o título da sua acusação: O REI DOS JUDEUS.
verses.en_web: The superscription of his accusation was written over him, “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
verses.en_bbe: And the statement of his crime was put in writing on the cross, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

verses.en: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.
verses.pt: Também, com ele, crucificaram dois salteadores, um à sua direita, e outro à esquerda.
verses.en_web: With him they crucified two robbers; one on his right hand, and one on his left.
verses.en_bbe: And they put two thieves on crosses with him, one on his right side, and one on his left.

verses.en: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.
verses.pt: [E cumpriu-se a escritura que diz: E com os malfeitores foi contado.]
verses.en_web: The Scripture was fulfilled, which says, “He was counted with transgressors.”

verses.en: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,
verses.pt: E os que iam passando blasfemavam dele, meneando a cabeça e dizendo: Ah! tu que destróis o santuário e em três dias o reedificas.
verses.en_web: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads, and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple, and build it in three days,
verses.en_bbe: And those who went by made sport of him, shaking their heads, and saying, Ha! you who give the Temple to destruction, and put it up again in three days,

verses.en: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.
verses.pt: salva-te a ti mesmo, descendo da cruz.
verses.en_web: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”
verses.en_bbe: Keep yourself from death, and come down from the cross.

verses.en: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.
verses.pt: De igual modo também os principais sacerdotes, com os escribas, escarnecendo-o, diziam entre si: A outros salvou; a si mesmo não pode salvar;
verses.en_web: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.
verses.en_bbe: In the same way the chief priests, laughing at him among themselves with the scribes, said, A saviour of others, he has no salvation for himself.

verses.en: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.
verses.pt: desça agora da cruz o Cristo, o rei de Israel, para que vejamos e creiamos, Também os que com ele foram crucificados o injuriavam.
verses.en_web: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.” Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.
verses.en_bbe: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, come down now from the cross, so that we may see and have belief. And those who were put on crosses with him said evil things against him.

verses.en: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
verses.pt: E, chegada a hora sexta, houve trevas sobre a terra, até a hora nona.
verses.en_web: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
verses.en_bbe: And when the sixth hour had come, it was dark over all the land till the ninth hour.

verses.en: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
verses.pt: E, à hora nona, bradou Jesus em alta voz: Eloí, Eloí, lamá, sabactani? que, traduzido, é: Deus meu, Deus meu, por que me desamparaste?
verses.en_web: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”
verses.en_bbe: And at the ninth hour, Jesus said in a loud voice, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, My God, my God, why are you turned away from me?

verses.en: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.
verses.pt: Alguns dos que ali estavam, ouvindo isso, diziam: Eis que chama por Elias.
verses.en_web: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”
verses.en_bbe: And some of those who were near, hearing it, said, See, he is crying to Elijah.

verses.en: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.
verses.pt: Correu um deles, ensopou uma esponja em vinagre e, pondo-a numa cana, dava-lhe de beber, dizendo: Deixai, vejamos se Elias virá tirá-lo.
verses.en_web: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”
verses.en_bbe: And one of them went quickly and, getting a sponge full of bitter wine, put it on a rod, and gave it to him for drink, saying, Let be; let us see if Elijah will come to take him down.

verses.en: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
verses.pt: Mas Jesus, dando um grande brado, expirou.
verses.en_web: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus gave a loud cry, and gave up his spirit.

verses.en: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.
verses.pt: Então o véu do santuário se rasgou em dois, de alto a baixo.
verses.en_web: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.
verses.en_bbe: And the curtain of the Temple was parted in two from end to end.

verses.en: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
verses.pt: Ora, o centurião, que estava defronte dele, vendo-o assim expirar, disse: Verdadeiramente este homem era filho de Deus.
verses.en_web: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”
verses.en_bbe: And when the captain, who was near, saw how he gave up his spirit, he said, Truly this man was a son of God.

verses.en: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
verses.pt: Também ali estavam algumas mulheres olhando de longe, entre elas Maria Madalena, Maria, mãe de Tiago o Menor e de José, e Salomé;
verses.en_web: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
verses.en_bbe: And there were women watching from a distance: among them were Mary Magdalene, and Mary, the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome,

verses.en: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.
verses.pt: as quais o seguiam e o serviam quando ele estava na Galiléia; e muitas outras que tinham subido com ele a Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: Who went with him when he was in Galilee and took care of him; and a number of other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

verses.en: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,
verses.pt: Ao cair da tarde, como era o dia da preparação, isto é, a véspera do sábado,
verses.en_web: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,
verses.en_bbe: And when it was evening, because it was the time of getting ready, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

verses.en: Joseph of Arimathaea, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.
verses.pt: José de Arimatéia, ilustre membro do sinédrio, que também esperava o reino de Deus, cobrando ânimo foi Pilatos e pediu o corpo de Jesus.
verses.en_web: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for God’s Kingdom, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.
verses.en_bbe: There came Joseph of Arimathaea, a responsible man in high honour, who was himself waiting for the kingdom of God; and he went in to Pilate without fear, and made a request for the body of Jesus.

verses.en: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
verses.pt: Admirou-se Pilatos de que já tivesse morrido; e chamando o centurião, perguntou-lhe se, de fato, havia morrido.
verses.en_web: Pilate marveled if he were already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.
verses.en_bbe: And Pilate was surprised that he was dead; and, sending for the captain, he put a question to see if he had been dead for long.

verses.en: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.
verses.pt: E, depois que o soube do centurião, cedeu o cadáver a José;
verses.en_web: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.
verses.en_bbe: And when he had news of it from the captain, he let Joseph have the body.

verses.en: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.
verses.pt: o qual, tendo comprado um pano de linho, tirou da cruz o corpo, envolveu-o no pano e o depositou num sepulcro aberto em rocha; e rolou uma pedra para a porta do sepulcro.
verses.en_web: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.
verses.en_bbe: And he got a linen cloth and, taking him down, put the linen cloth round him, and put him in a place for the dead which had been cut out of a rock; and a stone was rolled against the door.

verses.en: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.
verses.pt: E Maria Madalena e Maria, mãe de José, observavam onde fora posto.
verses.en_web: Mary Magdalene and Mary, the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.
verses.en_bbe: And Mary Magdalene and Mary, the mother of Joses, saw where he was put.
